llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple classic scam indicators, including promises of high-value products for a trivial fee, urgency/limited-time tactics, requirement to pay shipping for a 'free' prize, spoofing of a reputable retailer (Best Buy), multiple unverifiable positive testimonials, ambiguous privacy and policy notations, and lack of transparent business details. These align well with the common characteristics of fake online shopping scam sites.
